aisdlc — structural search over .NET code + live Azure infrastructure

USAGE
  aisdlc <module> <verb> [arguments]

MODULES
  ask      Unified query — `--env` switches structure ↔ environment snapshot
  skeleton Derive & inspect the env-name-free skeleton (abstract infra + SQL)
  code    Roslyn-based static analysis of the local .NET solution
  azure   Live Azure inventory (environments, services, resources, RBAC, alerts, log pipes)
  sql     Azure SQL + PostgreSQL schema index (tables, columns, FK graph)
  logs    Log Analytics workspace schemas (tables + columns) for KQL composition
  flutter Flutter / Dart mobile structural scan (screens, widgets, routes, http, providers)
  app     Logical applications that bridge code, infra, and observability
  bridge  Auto-link code references to live Azure entities; unresolved → LLM worklist
  llm-setup  Paste-ready prompt to delegate full install+setup to an LLM
             (`aisdlc llm-setup --cheatsheet` = the use-instead-of-grep reference)

COMMON FLOWS
  aisdlc code init                                # parse current solution
  aisdlc azure env add prod --subscription <id> --rg <name>
  aisdlc azure scan --env prod                    # snapshot prod into .aisdlc/infra-index.json
  aisdlc app add users-api --description "..."
  aisdlc app attach entry-point users-api --id ep_abc123
  aisdlc app attach service users-api --env prod --service users-api-prod
  aisdlc app trace users-api --env prod           # end-to-end view

aisdlc sql — register databases and query their schemas (Azure SQL + PostgreSQL)

CONFIG (.aisdlc/sql-config.yaml)
  init [--force]
  db add <name> --env <env> --kind azure-sql|postgres
                --server <host> --database <name>
                [--port <n>]
                (Postgres auth — pick ONE:
                   --aad-user <name>                       # Entra-ID token
                   --pg-user <name> --password-env <VAR>   # password from env var)
                [--exclude-schema <s>[,<s>...]] [--exclude-table <pat>[,...]]
                [--include-schema <s>[,<s>...]] [--include-table <pat>[,...]]
  db add-many   --env <env> --kind azure-sql|postgres --server <host>
                --dbs <[name=]db>[,<[name=]db>...]
                [--port <n>] [--aad-user <name>]
                [filter flags as above]
      Bulk-register many databases sharing the same env/server/auth/filters.
      Each --dbs token is `[<logical-name>=]<physical-db>`; bare names imply
      logical == physical.
  db list
  db show <name>
  db remove <name>

  defaults set   [--exclude-schema ...] [--exclude-table ...]
                 [--include-schema ...] [--include-table ...]
      Filters that apply to every database. Per-DB filters are unioned
      on top: a DB can layer on extra rules but cannot undo a default.
  defaults show
  defaults clear

SCAN (.aisdlc/sql-index.json)
  scan [--db <name>] [--env <env>] [--config <path>] [--output <path>]
      Connects via Azure AD / Managed Identity, reads INFORMATION_SCHEMA
      + sys.foreign_keys (Azure SQL) / pg_constraint (Postgres), writes
      the snapshot to .aisdlc/sql-index.json.

QUERIES (read from sql-index.json)
  tables  [--db <n>] [--schema <s>]
  columns <[schema.]table> [--db <n>]
  deps    <[schema.]table> [--db <n>] [--depth N]
      Outbound FK closure (insert-order topological sort) + inbound
      edges + cycle detection. The killer query for "replicate this
      entity in another env with all its dependencies".
[truncated]
